_comment: NSSTA training programmes approved by TPAC (Training Programme Approval Committee, chaired by DG Coordination & Administration, NSO, MoSPI), taken from the published NSSTA Advance Training Calendar FY 2025-26. These are scheduled, mostly classroom programmes with a fixed batch size that an officer is nominated for by their department - not self-paced online courses. They are served through the same catalogue contract as iGOT courses so the gap engine ranks both, and carry source=nssta plus eligibility, mode and duration_days so the UI can ask for nomination rather than offering enrolment. Source: mospi.gov.in NSSTA Advance Training Calendar FY(25-26).
